findings.current: I’m certain that if the Martial God had remained in his prime, they would have thought twice.
findings.defect: “In his prime” implies youth rather than continued strength, while “thought twice” stops short of the different decision Cheongheoja asserts.
findings.rationale: 건재 describes his continued presence and strength; 마음을 달리 먹었을 states that they would have changed their minds.
findings.replacement: I’m certain that if the Martial God had still been around and strong, they would have made a different choice.
findings.source: 적어도 무신께서 건재하셨다면 그들 또한 마음을 달리 먹었을 것이라 확신할 수 있지.

findings.current: It wasn’t as if he were Geum Jandi, honorary Sect Leader of the Golden Grass or something.[^1]
findings.defect: “Of the Golden Grass” invents a sect absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The Korean calls Geum Jandi an honorary Sect Leader without naming a sect.
findings.replacement: It wasn’t as if he were Geum Jandi, honorary Sect Leader, or anything.[^1]

findings.current: But the countless townspeople filling the main road lowered their voices to a whisper and made way.
findings.defect: The crowd quiets even its breathing, not merely its voices.
findings.rationale: 숨소리마저 emphasizes how completely the crowd falls silent.
findings.replacement: But the countless townspeople filling the main road made way, scarcely daring to breathe.
findings.source: 수많은 백성은 숨소리마저 낮춘 채 길을 비켰다.

findings.current: “Couldn’t ask for better weather if you wanted to die.”
findings.defect: Reverses Jin’s reaction: this is weather that makes him not want to die.
findings.rationale: 죽기 싫은 explicitly means not wanting to die.
findings.replacement: “Exactly the kind of weather that makes you not want to die.”

findings.current:
The whistle that marked the beginning of the battle—one that would decide the fate of Qinghai, or perhaps all under heaven—cut through the air.

*Shhheeeek!*

In the form of hundreds of ice spikes.
findings.defect: Turns the projectile opening the battle into a whistle or sound.
findings.rationale: 효시 is the opening shot; the next line identifies its physical form as hundreds of ice spikes.
findings.replacement:
The opening shot of the battle—one that would decide the fate of Qinghai, or perhaps all under heaven—cut through the air.

*Shhheeeek!*

In the form of hundreds of ice spikes.
findings.source:
청해성. 아니 어쩌면 천하의 운명을 결정지을 전투의 시작을 알리는 효시(嚆矢)가 허공을 가로질렀다.

쐐애애액!

수백 개에 달하는 얼음송곳의 형태로.

summary: Five actionable fidelity and wording findings.
